head: WORKTREE
summary: Transaction record validates in its canonical constructor: at least two lines, one account per line, one currency, sum zero, overflow via Money.plus addExact. Every brief criterion has a named test; mutation run reports 43/43 killed. No findings of note.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: TransactionTest#rejectsTransactionWithoutLines, #rejectsTransactionWithASingleLine, #rejectsTransactionWhoseLinesSumAboveZero/BelowZero, #rejectsLinesInMoreThanOneCurrency, #rejectsTwoLinesOnTheSameAccount; all DomainException subtypes with cause in message. Canonical constructor serves as the factory.
TransactionTest#overflowWhileSummingLinesFailsInsteadOfWrappingAround (Long.MAX_VALUE + 1 throws ArithmeticException via Money.plus Math.addExact, Money.java:38).
TransactionTest: one test per rejection, plus #acceptsABalancedTwoLineTransaction and #acceptsABalancedMultiLineTransaction; mutation gate 43/43 killed per orchestrator.

findings.description: The overflow test asserts only ArithmeticException with no message or cause check, so any other arithmetic failure would satisfy it. Acceptable because the input is deterministic.
